qualification.method: Five fresh database copies per workload/profile; every repeat retained and checked individually.
qualification.warmup: 100 real claims per process; timed runs reuse the measured pools and worker identities, retain the excluded samples separately, and omit simulated work delays only during warm-up.
qualification.candidate_scope: Returned task index entries and sequential task rows per call, including repeated visits, warm-up and empty calls. Internal B-tree comparisons and heap-chain traversal are not counted.
qualification.instrumentation: Fixture wrapper calls the unchanged production scheduler function; recording overhead remains inside claim latency and lock occupancy.
qualification.host_activity: Task-owned compilation, correctness tests and their disposable database stopped before measurement. Profiles ran sequentially; normal desktop activity continued.
qualification.scope: Qualification of the recorded workloads and host, not a universal hardware performance or physical candidate-work guarantee.

preceding_hosted_run.note: Raw failures retained. This earlier source used separate-process timed warm-up; the new source also integrates audit/recovery. No isolated causal speed-up is claimed.

manifest.warmup: 100 excluded claims per process; timed runs warm the same pools and worker identities without simulated work delays, retaining separate samples
